what: a 4 mm fillet on a top edge whose round overlaps the rim of a through hole (the hole breaks into the round)
method: block 40x20x10 minus a through hole of r=3 centred (20,14.5), then R4 on the top long edge at y=20 (round covers y=16..20, removes 40*(16-4pi) = 137.35 from the plain block). Where the hole reaches into the round (y>16) the two removals overlap: that volume is counted twice by 137.35 + 282.74, so add it back: overlap = integral over y from 16 to 17.5 of [4 - sqrt(16-(y-16)^2)] (height removed by the round) x 2 sqrt(9-(y-14.5)^2) (chord of the hole) dy = 0.3758 (Simpson, 40000 steps). V = 8000 - 9*pi*10 - 40*(16-4*pi) + overlap = 7580.287.
